title: The sugar-glass garden
alt: Translucent sugar leaves and pale pink flowers decorate an ivory cake, with its cut slice on a plate to the right.
description: Detailed pastry materials and a consistent sliced-cake structure in a softly lit botanical composition.
prompt: A sophisticated pastry photograph of one elaborate round cake displayed on a complete white porcelain cake stand. Smooth ivory icing is decorated with an airy edible garden of translucent sugar-glass leaves, pale pink pulled-sugar flowers and thin golden branches, all visibly attached to the top. A cut wedge of cake on a small matching plate at the right reveals neat layers, and the main cake has the corresponding wedge missing. Refined patisserie styling, pale blue background, realistic sugar translucency and cream textures, no text.
